subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` remain a PreToolUse-only opt-out, or should it intentionally disable the paired loop-detection PreToolUse/PostToolUse behavior?
rationale: This is an existing public configuration contract, and the branch documentation plus earlier discussion identify two materially different upgrade behaviors that code review alone cannot choose.

options.title: Preserve the historical narrow opt-out
options.body: Keep `false` limited to the historical PreToolUse relay behavior and add final-head proof plus focused configuration coverage for any PostToolUse relay that remains necessary.

options.title: Adopt a paired loop-relay opt-out
options.body: Treat `false` as disabling the loop-detection PreToolUse/PostToolUse pair, but document the upgrade behavior clearly and obtain explicit maintainer acceptance for the compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Preserve the historical narrow opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep `false` limited to the historical PreToolUse relay behavior and add final-head proof plus focused configuration coverage for any PostToolUse relay that remains necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has isolated the precise contract choice and can implement the selected behavior, while the final accept/reject decision remains with repository maintainers.
